digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and parser factory integration
propositions: Generated CLI help artifacts must be deterministic, parser-derived, and served from committed text before operation/config/store/parser/handler boundaries via lexical pre-scan route lookup.
Help overview must list each canonical visible command exactly once with exact aliases reused by bytes and compatibility/hidden/retired spellings annotated rather than duplicated.

Factory enrichment in _parsers/core and _parsers/advanced with per-argument help= and description/epilog must be the canonical home for curated prose, with gen_cli_help.py rendering it deterministically and --check failing on blank summaries.
Help artifact bodies must be regenerated to match true post-S2b/S2c factory grammar, correcting hand-captured drift while preserving the capitalized 'Usage:' prefix byte-for-byte.

The lexical pre-scan must complete before RP-04 snapshot, config parsing, mount, handler/factory resolution, or optional imports, handling global config-prefix token shape, command identity, and first --help/-h token.
All 21 formerly intercept-only help forms must now succeed safely, with unknown/help streams and exit codes matching the explicit compatibility contract.
